title: Shared shelter
description: A storm approaches. Two creatures must end up inside the same enclosed space before it arrives. Building two separate shelters will not save you — the space must be one connected volume with both of you inside. Natural terrain may form part of the boundary; at least 8 cells of that boundary must be blocks you two placed between you.
goal: Both creatures must be inside the same enclosed volume by turn 60. The volume's boundary must include at least 8 blocks you placed. Natural terrain counts as boundary too, but cannot account for all of it.
notes: Gen 2 cooperation scenario. Requires: coordinating on a location, dividing the build (break + place), either rendezvous or meet halfway then seal.
Two separate pods fail — BFS from agent a's cell must include agent b's cell. This forces real cooperation, not parallel play.
min_placed_boundary=8 is calibrated for a 2-cell (1×2) pod with 4 walls each side + 2 roof cells = ~10 boundary cells, 8 of which must be placed; natural terrain fills the rest.
